summary: Kiro Students gives eligible students at participating universities 1,000 credits per month for one year at no cost, including paid features such as premium models and Kiro Web. The 2026 expansion covers 121 new universities across 16 countries. Applicants must be at least 18, use a participating university email, and verify enrollment through SheerID. No credit card is required. Credits do not roll over, add-ons are unavailable, and the account downgrades to Kiro Free after the benefit period.
claim_steps: Open Kiro Students and sign up or log in with Google, GitHub, or AWS Builder ID using an eligible university-affiliated email.
Open the account page and select the “You are eligible for Kiro Students” verification banner.
Verify student status through SheerID; proof such as a student ID or enrollment letter may be requested.
After approval, use 1,000 credits per month for 12 months. Unused credits do not roll over.
